_comment: This is the only skill in the catalog whose declared workflow takes actions with real, non-reversible side effects on running infrastructure: restart_enterprise_service restarts a live service, and update_it_ticket_status writes back to the incident system of record. The SKILL.md body also contemplates run_command / edit_file against local docker-compose settings. Declared accordingly rather than optimistically: execution requires approval, workspace_write and network are true. Do not relax these without changing the workflow first.
